name: Reusable Bag Door-Station Organizer
description: Create a printable reusable bag collection map and weekly reset card that sorts existing bags by size, assigns safe door stations, and builds simple grab-and-return rules without requiring purchases.
use_cases: Create a safe door-station map for reusable shopping bags.
Sort bag clutter by size, purpose, and weekly use.
Build a printable weekly reset card for returning bags to their stations.
safety_notes: No purchases required; use current bags and existing safe storage spots first.
Keep storage out of stairs, hallways, door swing areas, exits, heat sources, and other unsafe walk paths.
Do not provide structural installation advice or recommend overloaded hooks or shelves.
